note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Mukherjee et al. (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India, fauna of the Isoptera of the Himalaya); the original is in English; the original description is in Thakur & Rathore 1986; the original gives Imago: Unknown, and only the soldier is described. Table 54 gives soldier measurements, but after the OCR line breaks the figures of three species (O. prolatigula / O. redemanni / O. sikkimensis) interleave and some cells are missing, so they cannot be assigned reliably and no figures are transcribed.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Very close to O. boveni, from which it can be separated by the narrower soldier head (the Remarks of the original). Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and antennae yellow to yellowish brown, uniform in colour; pronotum and body straw yellow, much paler than the head. Head broadly oval, widest in the posterior third. Fontanelle spot not evident. Antennae 15—16-segmented, segment 2 about one and a half times as long as segment 3; segment 3 shortest. Labrum tongue-shaped, pilose. Mandibles sickle-shaped, short, slightly more than half the head length, apex weakly incurved; left mandible with one prominent sharp tooth near the upper margin of the apical third. Postmentum subrectangular, sides markedly arched, abruptly narrowed at the anterior quarter; anterior margin nearly straight, posterior margin weakly concave. Pronotum saddle-shaped, distinctly narrower than the head width; anterior margin weakly but distinctly notched in the middle; posterior margin broadly concave in the middle.
